gloss: to be short-handed; to not have enough help

definitions.gloss: to be short-handed; to lack enough people to do the work
definitions.explanation: For there not to be enough people available for the work at hand. Literally 'hands are insufficient' — {手|て} stands for working hands, as in English 'we're short-handed.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手|て}が{足|た}りない。
{手|て}が{足|た}りない⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We're short-handed, so we decided to take on more part-timers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えて→増える：01183_fueru⟧、⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧{手|て}が{足|た}りなく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Orders pick up at the end of the year, so we inevitably end up short-handed.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手|て}が{足|た}りない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: I expect we'll be short-handed on moving day, so I'm planning to have friends come too.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand, worker) + ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ + ⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ (to be insufficient).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手|て}が{足|た}りない: we're short-handed
- {手|て}が{足|た}りなく⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up short-handed
- ⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to be short of staff (the same idea with the noun ⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧; slightly more formal, common in news writing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{人手不足|ひとでぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧: labor shortage — the noun used for the long-term, industry-wide problem
- ⟦{猫|ねこ}の{手|て}も{借|か}りたい→猫の手も借りたい：06215_nekonotemokaritai⟧: so busy one would borrow a cat's paws — a vivid idiom for the same situation

USAGE:
Use it for a temporary shortfall on a particular day or job; a chronic shortage is ⟦{人手不足|ひとでぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧.
